parameters.text: Could not complete the inventory. (1) get_examples returned 0 training labels for this area, and no new labels may be collected, so few_shot, concept_vector and linear_probe have no positives. (2) zero_shot_text is not configured. (3) imagery_window refused both gsi-seamless-aerial-japan and sentinel-2-l2a-cogs ("no imagery source"), so I could not view any chip. (4) The only embedding index I built is a synthetic fixture (aef 160 m, 3430 cells, 16 dims, not real AlphaEarth). I chose 160 m because it is the finest cell and warehouses are at least 40 m across. Clay at 1280 m is too coarse. Searched: none was actually reviewed. Unreviewed: the whole AOI (136.72-136.82E, 35.38-35.45N, about 71 km2). I give no warehouse count and no points, because any list would be fabricated and ungrounded. Transfer: with labelled examples and imagery, I expect an embedding shortlist plus aerial verification to transfer only partly. 10 m embeddings confuse warehouses with factories and large markets, so aerial verification would still be needed, and this AOI is a mixed industrial/urban/rural area.
